key_insight: LSPO recovers missing reinforcement-learning signal on "cliff" prompts by briefly adding a low-rank supervised adapter, re-sampling successful answers, and then updating the base model with GRPO.
engineering_relevance: It offers a practical way to improve math-reasoning RL when many frontier prompts produce zero reward, without permanently changing the deployed model architecture.
method: Fit a small LoRA adapter on ground-truth solutions for those prompts.
Re-roll completions with base+adapter, splice successes into the RL batch with importance-sampling correction, and discard the adapter at checkpoint.
evidence_signal: In DeepMath-103K with DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-1.5B over 5 paired seeds and a matched 1000-step horizon, LSPO matched or beat DAPO on all 16 benchmark/pass@k cells, with an average gain of +3.8 points.
watch_item: The approach depends on having ground-truth solutions available for cliff prompts and adds an extra supervised fitting/sampling stage that may increase training complexity.
paper_title: LoRA Scaffolded Policy Optimization (LSPO): A Sampling-Time Low-Rank Scaffold for Recovering Reinforcement-Learning Gradient on Zero-Reward Cliff Prompts
